title: Cross-agent failed-candidate broadcast contract (L22)
description: Shared anti-knowledge via bridge events. See ADR-032.

invariants.name: event_schema_required_fields
invariants.description: Event has fixed required fields. Validator rejects events missing any.
must: all 7 required_fields present on every event
missing field -> validator error
extra fields allowed but ignored by consumers

invariants.name: hash_normalization
invariants.description: candidate_class_hash = sha256(normalized candidate structure). Normalization: sorted keys + lowercased terms.
must: two normalization implementations produce identical hash for equivalent candidates
normalization rule documented in implementation (sorted keys, lowercased string terms)
hash is full sha256 hex (64 chars)

invariants.name: ttl_bounded
invariants.description: ttl_hours default 720 (30 days). Pinned upper bound 8760 (1 year). Operator-tunable in range.
must: default 720
upper bound 8760 hardcoded in this contract
validator rejects ttl_hours > 8760 or <= 0

invariants.name: bridge_mediated_only
invariants.description: No shared database. All anti-knowledge transfer via bridge events.jsonl.
must: no database table for anti-knowledge
publisher writes to events.jsonl ONLY
subscribers consume from events.jsonl ONLY

invariants.name: per_agent_local_cache
invariants.description: Each agent maintains its own anti-knowledge cache. No central service.
must: no shared anti-knowledge service in waggledance/core
each agent has its own AntiKnowledgeCache instance
cache state is per-agent, not per-swarm

invariants.name: ttl_eviction
invariants.description: Entries older than ttl_hours evicted lazily on miner check.
must: cache check compares (now - entry_ts) against ttl_hours
expired entries removed during lookup OR by periodic sweep
expired entries do NOT block re-broadcast

invariants.name: subscriber_idempotency
invariants.description: Subscriber consuming the same broadcast event twice MUST NOT double-count it.
must: dedup by (candidate_class_hash, rejecting_agent_id, rejected_at_utc) or event uuid
second consumption of same event is a no-op
test verifies idempotency by replaying event stream
